verdict.rationale: Vue's own site lists Vue Router under "Official Libraries", which establishes it as a first-party routing library. Multiple community reports praise the official vue-router as easy to adopt alongside the framework. missing for 10: in-depth first-party Vue Router documentation in the pack (features, integration APIs, Vue 3 composition integration), and concrete hands-on evidence of the seamless integration beyond brief anecdotes.

support.subject: As a developer, I can use an official first-party routing library that integrates seamlessly with the framework

citations.quote: Official Libraries: Vue Router, Pinia, Tooling Guide
Vue has an official router and store (Vuex)
Vue's official vuex and vue-router, plus vue-cli scaffolding, make it easy to iterate on prototypes
